parsed.answer: In Rpl38 mutant mouse embryos, global protein synthesis is unchanged, yet the translation of a select subset of Homeobox (Hox) mRNAs is perturbed, with RPL38 facilitating 80S complex formation on these mRNAs to confer transcript-specific translational control. This directly matches the claim that Rpl38 reduction alters Hox mRNA translation composition without lowering overall protein synthesis. The other excerpts concern p38MAPK signaling and Myc-driven translation and do not bear on Rpl38.
